description: A linear collection of data elements whose order is not given by their physical placement in memory. Instead, each element points to the next.

insert_end.name: Insert at End
insert_end.description: Inserts a new element at the tail of the singly linked list.

insert_beginning.name: Insert at Beginning
insert_beginning.description: Inserts a new element at the head of the list.

delete_end.name: Delete from End
delete_end.description: Deletes the last element of the list.

reverse.name: Reverse List
reverse.description: Reverses the direction of pointers in the singly linked list.
